column1: # One line per manifest reason: <element name>\t<sha256(reason)[:16]>.
# Why a digest baseline and not another pattern (#380):
# three versions of a per-row literal list went stale, and the property floor
#   "Not supported by the engine. Not supported by the engine. Not supported."
# -- 72 characters, matching on `engine`. A syntactic floor cannot tell a
# measurement from a sentence shaped like one. A digest can: changing any
# reason fails here, and the fix is to update this file in the same commit,
# which makes the change deliberate and reviewable instead of silent.
# (see its remarks), and say in the commit message WHY the reason changed.
